tasks.title: Add Circular Dependency Detection
tasks.description: Implement circular dependency detection in the subscription system to prevent infinite render loops. This is the most critical Major issue as it can cause runtime errors that are difficult to debug.

subtasks.title: Create cycle detection utility module
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Circular dependency detection should use DFS algorithm with recursion stack tracking. External research provides algorithm patterns in plan_bugfix/architecture/external_deps.md.
2. INPUT: New file packages/react/src/utils/cycleDetection.ts (does not exist yet). Subscription graph structure is Map<string, Set<string>> where keys are targets and values are sets of subscribers.
3. LOGIC: Implement wouldCreateCycle(graph: Map<string, Set<string>>, target: string, subscriber: string): boolean function. Use DFS algorithm with two Sets: visiting (current path) and visited (fully processed). Temporarily add edge (subscriber → target) to graph and check for cycles starting from subscriber. Implement getCyclePath(graph: Map<string, Set<string>>, start: string): string to return cycle path like 'fieldA → fieldB → fieldC → fieldA'.
4. OUTPUT: New utility module with exported functions wouldCreateCycle and getCyclePath. Both functions are pure and have no side effects.

subtasks.title: Integrate cycle detection into Form.addSubscription
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: addSubscription function is at packages/react/src/components/Form.tsx:212-230. Currently no cycle detection.
2. INPUT: Form.tsx with addSubscription function. Cycle detection utility from P1.M1.T3.S1. invertedSubscriptions is a ref containing Map<string, Set<string>>.
3. LOGIC: Import wouldCreateCycle and getCyclePath from '../utils/cycleDetection'. At start of addSubscription, call wouldCreateCycle(invertedSubscriptions.current, target, subscriber). If true, construct comprehensive error message using getCyclePath. Throw Error with message containing: cycle path, explanation of consequences, possible solutions (refactor, computed fields, FieldGroup), and documentation link. Only proceed with subscription if no cycle detected.
4. OUTPUT: Updated addSubscription function that detects and prevents circular dependencies before they're added to subscription graph.

3. LOGIC: Create packages/react/src/utils/cycleDetection.test.ts. Write test cases: no cycle (linear chain A→B→C), simple cycle (A→B→A), complex cycle (A→B→C→A), self-cycle (A→A), disconnected graphs, large graph (50+ nodes), multiple cycles. Use describe blocks for organization. Test both wouldCreateCycle and getCyclePath functions. Mock graph structures using Map.
4. OUTPUT: Test suite with 10+ test cases covering all cycle detection scenarios. All tests pass.
